en.title: Mix RGB Colors with One Button | ESP32 From Zero #6
en.description:
Make eight colors with one RGB LED, then choose colors and a smooth fade with a button. Learn setColor(), common cathode and common anode, a mode counter and ground-wire troubleshooting. Your challenge: a smart camping headlamp.

Code + lesson: https://github.com/emjnbulut/esp32-from-zero/tree/main/lessons/06-rgb
Learning Lab: https://emjnbulut.github.io/esp32-learning-lab/
Course source: https://github.com/emjnbulut/esp32-from-zero

0:00 One LED, your colors
0:23 Recall: PWM and the loop
1:14 Three LEDs in one
1:53 Wire RGB safely
3:15 The setColor() helper
4:08 rgb_colors code tour
5:19 Common ground mistake
5:59 A button and four modes
6:49 color_modes code tour
8:29 Your turn: camping headlamp
8:53 Recap and next lesson
